notes.subject: ומפני
notes.rationale: Fɔcogɔw bɛ wuli: 'n'ka ɲɛ' (ASV/JPS) walima 'ne ɲɛfɛ' walima 'a ɲɛ' (YLT 'before me He covered'); nin bayɛlɛmali bɔla 'n'ka ɲɛ' la ni nɔnabila ⟨a⟩ farali ye.

notes.subject: אפל
notes.rationale: אֹפֶל (gibidibi) ye daɲɛ dɔgɔnnen ye Tanaki kɔnɔ; a nɔ na חֹשֶׁךְ (dibi) bɛ kuntilenna-cogoya dilan.

notes.subject: נצמתי
notes.rationale: צָמַת ye 'ka bɔ kokura ka kabali tigɛ' kɔrɔ; bayɛlɛmali dɔw b'a fɔ 'silenced' (BSB) — nin ye kɔrɔ-yɛlɛma ye.

notes.subject: dibi
notes.rationale: Ayuba ka kuma bɛ sinsin dibi kunminɛbaw kan minnu ma jira kalankɔrɔyɔrɔ la — Yeelen ni dibi cogoya min bɛ a kɔrɔkɔrɔ fɔliw mara.

translation: Sabu dibi ɲɛma ne ma kabali-tigɛ, ani ⟨a⟩ ye gibidibi datugu ne ɲɛ ɲɛ.
